evidence.notes: Creates a local org-state snapshot before a DML mutation.
Restores a selected local snapshot and removes later inserted state.
Releases a local snapshot without rolling back current state.
The release-savepoint method family is exercised by the exact Savepoint call witness.

source.content: Account before = new Account(Name = 'Savepoint Before'); insert before; System.Savepoint rollbackPoint = Database.setSavepoint(); Account after = new Account(Name = 'Savepoint After'); insert after; List<Account> afterRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Savepoint After']; System.assertEquals(1, afterRows.size()); Database.rollback(rollbackPoint); List<Account> rolledBackRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Savepoint After']; System.assertEquals(0, rolledBackRows.size()); List<Account> beforeRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Savepoint Before']; System.assertEquals(1, beforeRows.size()); System.Savepoint releasePoint = Database.setSavepoint(); Account kept = new Account(Name = 'Savepoint Kept'); insert kept; Database.releaseSavepoint(releasePoint); List<Account> keptRows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Savepoint Kept']; System.assertEquals(1, keptRows.size());
